title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: AgentOPSD：用于智能体强化学习的递归自蒸馏
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards constructs trajectory-level advantage estimates, yet it often fails to credit the few pivotal decisions that determine outcomes in long-horizon, multi-turn agentic tasks. Recent work introduces privileged self-distillation for credit assignment, providing denser supervision, but it remains unclear how such local signals should represent sequential credit. We propose AgentOPSD, a critic-free, recursive method for turn-level credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning. AgentOPSD aggregates token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn-level evidence and recursively updates a Bayesian belief state in log-odds space. This yields a principled reweighting scheme that converts sparse outcome supervision into turn-level credit signals and identifies pivotal turns through the marginal belief revision between consecutive states. The method is fully compatible with standard policy optimization and requires neither an additional critic nor extra rollouts. We evaluate AgentOPSD on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA using Qwen2.5 models at two scales (3B and 7B). AgentOPSD outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines, achieving 89.1% success on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B. Ablation studies attribute the gains to turn-level aggregation and history-dependent recursive belief updates.
abstract_zh: 本文针对长程、多轮智能体任务中的信用分配难题提出 AgentOPSD。现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习通常只能构造轨迹级优势估计，难以识别决定任务成败的少数关键决策；而已有 privileged self-distillation 虽能提供更密集监督，但如何表达序列信用仍不明确。AgentOPSD 是一种无需 critic、无需额外 rollout 的递归回合级信用分配方法：它将 token 级 teacher-student log-probability gap 聚合为 turn-level evidence，并在 log-odds 空间中递归更新 Bayesian belief state，从而把稀疏结果监督转化为回合级信用信号，并通过相邻 belief state 的边际修正识别关键回合。该方法可直接兼容标准 policy optimization。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上使用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 评估，AgentOPSD 超越 GRPO 和强自蒸馏基线，其中 Qwen2.5-7B 在 ALFWorld 上达到 89.1% 成功率。消融表明，性能提升主要来自回合级聚合与依赖历史的递归 belief update。
key_points_zh: 提出 AgentOPSD，用于长程多轮 agentic RL 中的 turn-level credit assignment，缓解轨迹级奖励难以定位关键决策的问题。
方法将 token 级 teacher-student log-probability gap 聚合为回合级证据，并在 log-odds 空间递归更新 Bayesian belief state。
通过相邻 belief state 的 marginal belief revision 识别 pivotal turns，将稀疏 outcome supervision 转化为更细粒度的回合级训练信号。
AgentOPSD 无需额外 critic 或额外 rollouts，可与标准 policy optimization 兼容，工程集成成本较低。
在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 上使用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 验证，优于 GRPO 和强 self-distillation baseline；Qwen2.5-7B 在 ALFWorld 达到 89.1% success rate。

llm_assessment.comment: A well-aligned agentic RL paper addressing long-horizon credit assignment with turn-level recursive self-distillation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这篇论文高度契合智能体强化学习方向，用轮次级递归自蒸馏解决长程任务信用分配问题。
